meta.description: Farnsworth chat-agent run_command isolation profile. v0.1.0 (Jul 13 ~17:35 ET): wraps child_process.exec in nono Seatbelt. NO commands.deny (we ARE running a shell). Includes claude_code_macos for language-runtime grants (node/python/rust) + git_config + unlink_protection. Workdir is readwrite so npm install/git commit/etc. work. filesystem.deny on ~/.aws + ~/.ssh + ~/.gnupg + ~/.config/gh + /etc/shadow + /etc/sudoers (Seatbelt kernel-enforced). network_profile: developer + allow_domain for Anthropic -- currently best-effort only (nono v0.66 strict allowlist only fires from CLI flag, not profile field; tracking for future nono versions). Verified Jul 13 ~17:35 ET: shell runs, ~/.aws reads blocked, outside-cwd writes blocked, cwd writes allowed.
